summary: Students suggest providing essential needs such as food, clothing, and shelter, as well as financial assistance to support impoverished families and the homeless.
Students are requesting enhanced support from teachers to improve teaching methods and provide additional study time, with a particular emphasis on assisting students who are struggling academically.
Students are advocating for a healthier lifestyle, emphasizing the importance of increased physical activity, better nutrition, adequate sleep, and proper hydration.
The students advocate for a more inclusive and supportive school environment, emphasizing the importance of stopping bullying, fostering friendships, promoting kindness, and supporting lonely peers.
Students are requesting improved mental health support through additional counselors and better counseling services, emphasizing the need for professional guidance and someone to talk to.
